contents.text: {"answer":"Recall 24V868000 matches the reported failure: the owner said the car would not accelerate and reported an ICCU diagnosis, while the recall describes ICCU damage that can cause loss of drive power. The other candidate, 24V204000, describes the same failure but was replaced by 24V868000; even vehicles repaired under the earlier recall need the new remedy.","scope":"answered","recheck":false,"citations":[{"kind":"complaint","id":"11714455","quote":"Car would not accelerate"},{"kind":"complaint","id":"11714455","quote":"they said it is an ICCU failure"},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V868000","quote":"The Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) may become damaged and stop charging the 12-volt battery, which can result in a loss of drive power."},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V204000","quote":"The Integrated Charging Control Unit (ICCU) may become damaged and stop charging the 12-Volt battery, which can result in a loss of drive power."},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V204000","quote":"This recall is replaced by NHTSA recall number 24V-868."},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V868000","quote":"Vehicles previously repaired under recall 24V-204 will need to have the new remedy completed."}]}
